This role involves designing power electronic solutions, performing engineering analyses, and delivering hardware for integration and production.</p><p></p><p>This is an on-site role for Marlborough, MA or Tewksbury, MA</p><p></p><p><b>What You Will Do</b></p><ul><li>Leverage your mechanical and power design expertise to develop innovative technical solutions.</li><li>Lead the design and development of electrical power systems for radar platforms, including layout, power generation, and distribution.</li><li>Manage design-to-production transitions, ensuring seamless design releases into manufacturing.</li><li>Conduct complex tolerance analyses to verify form, fit, and function for radar applications.</li><li>Provide technical guidance to ensure products meet quality standards, performance requirements, and compliance regulations.</li><li>Lead small teams to meet project schedules, budgets, and technical goals while driving process improvements.</li><li>Collaborate with internal engineering disciplines, operations, systems teams, quality assurance, and suppliers.</li><li>Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders on significant technical matters.</li></ul><p><br /><b>Qualifications You Must Have</b></p><ul><li>Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and a minimum of 5 years of prior commercial applications.</li><li>Experience with ANSI/ASME Y14.5 Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&amp;T)</li></ul><p></p><p><b>Qualifications We Prefer</b></p><ul><li>Experience developing technical data packages and adhering to drawing standards.</li><li>Experience design of power and power conversion systems used in military or ruggedized applications.</li><li>Leadership experience in managing small development teams.</li><li>Experience with CREO (Pro/E) or similar 3D solid modeling software.</li><li>Knowledge of power design capabilities or have direct experience in power manufacturing and assembly.</li><li>Experience in selection of materials for structural, thermal, mechanical, electrical, producibility, and environmental considerations including corrosion mitigation and prevention.</li><li>Proficient in Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).</li><li>Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills for collaboration with cross-functional
